I will put most of the land into my usual wheat-maize rotation, because that is the most familiar and dependable system for me in Quzhou County, and I have well irrigation to support it. I will keep a smaller piece in cotton so I still have cash income, but I will not expand cotton because it takes more careful field management and more picking labor. On the wheat-maize land, I will use better seed, give moderate fertilizer, irrigate when the crop most needs it, and avoid excessive chemical use because my land is small and I need steady returns rather than high cost. For maize, I will use hybrid seed because it is the safest way for me to get stable yield on a small area. For cotton, I will use an improved variety, feed it with more potassium than grain crops, and manage insects carefully but not spray more than needed. I will use rotary tillage on most fields because it is practical on my small farm and fits my labor and cash situation.
